intent.name: intent
intent.description: Planner-supplied goal describing why the agent is being invoked.

seed_sources.name: seed_sources
seed_sources.description: Initial set of candidate sources or URLs to expand from.

budget.name: budget
budget.description: Per-run override for tokens, cost, and timeout.

board_context.name: board_context
board_context.description: Snapshot of the current board graph used for scoping.

planner_notes.name: planner_notes
planner_notes.description: Structured hints provided by the Planner agent.

sources.name: sources
sources.description: List of Source node identifiers to cluster.

hints.name: hints
hints.description: Optional grouping hints such as topic tags or manual folders.

scope_id.name: scope_id
scope_id.description: Identifier for the active scope being processed.

claims_index.name: claims_index
claims_index.description: Reference to indexed claims to guide synthesis output.

verifier_plan.name: verifier_plan
verifier_plan.description: Structured verification plan detailing checks to execute.

claim_ids.name: claim_ids
claim_ids.description: Explicit claim identifiers selected for verification.

open_questions.name: open_questions
open_questions.description: Outstanding questions or POR gaps discovered in the scope.

action.name: action
action.description: Resolved action template with parameters ready for execution.

approval.name: approval
approval.description: Verified approval artifact authorizing the workflow run.

board_graph.name: board_graph
board_graph.description: Snapshot of the board graph including trust annotations.

policies.name: policies
policies.description: Resolved policy bundle governing monitoring thresholds.

sources_pending.description: Candidate source nodes sequestered pending verification.

notes.description: Execution notes capturing provenance and follow-ups.

contains_edges.description: Edges linking Group nodes to member sources.

equivalent_to_edges.description: Edges capturing deduplicated or mirrored sources.

dedupe_report.description: Structured report describing grouping and dedupe decisions.

claimset_unverified.description: Draft claims extracted from the scoped sources.

citations.description: Citation records linking claims to evidence.

verifier_run.description: Verifier run artifact referencing executed checks.

claim_status_updates.description: Status transitions for claims (verified, contested, stale).

tasks.description: Prioritized follow-up tasks with responsible agents.

workflow_logs.description: Execution log lines emitted during workflow actions.

workflow_artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by executing the workflow action.

objective_ack.description: Acknowledgement claims confirming external action results.

monitor_diffs.description: Graph change proposals addressing trust drift.

trust_badges.description: Badge adjustments based on objectivity thresholds.

refresh_proposals.description: Recommended scopes for refresh or re-verification.

preconditions: Intent present and validated against LimitsPolicy.
Scope sequester rules confirm sources can be staged.
emits: Pending Source nodes flagged as sequestered.
SEQUESTERS edges from Source nodes to the active scope.
Execution notes documenting provenance and gaps.
restrictions: Never attach IN_SCOPE_FOR edges without explicit approval.
Respect gatherer_sources_allowlist unless Business override present.

preconditions: At least one Source node available.
No active dedupe operations in progress for the same board.
emits: Group nodes with CONTAINS edges binding members.
EQUIVALENT_TO edges when sources are canonical duplicates.
Dedupe report summarizing grouping heuristics and decisions.
restrictions: Must not delete or merge Source nodes directly.

preconditions: Scope_id resolves to a valid ScopeSet.
emits: Execution notes mapping claims to supporting evidence.
restrictions: Must tag claims lacking sufficient evidence for follow-up.

preconditions: Verifier plan enumerates each check with strategy and budget.
emits: Claim status updates (verified, contested, stale) with receipts.
restrictions: Cannot mark success without at least one completed check.
Must enqueue ApprovalRequest when encountering sequester conflicts.

preconditions: Scope_id or claims_index resolves to accessible data.
emits: UnifiedDoc.section with inline citations and ring tag.
restrictions: Must honor tier ring limits (Free → L0 only).
No deletion of upstream claims or notes.

preconditions: Open questions or objectivity deficits present.
emits: Task list referencing responsible agents and rationale.
restrictions: Cannot execute actions directly; must delegate via agents.

preconditions: Action template resolved with guardrail checks.
emits: Structured logs and artifacts for the completed action.
Optional ObjectiveClaim acknowledgement when evidence obtained.
restrictions: Enforce dry-run mode when approval scope is insufficient.

preconditions: Board graph snapshot and policies loaded.
emits: Badge updates reflecting current objectivity band.
restrictions: Must not mutate graph directly; changes go through graph PRs.

agents.purpose: Expand the active scope with high-quality candidate sources while respecting sequester limits.
plans: Validate intent and available budget against LimitsPolicy.
Expand candidate list using gatherer_sources_allowlist domains first.
Emit new Source nodes with SEQUESTERS edges and provenance notes.

agents.purpose: Cluster sources into coherent groups and dedupe overlapping material.
plans: Confirm available sources and lock overlapping dedupe sessions.
Generate candidate clusters using semantic and provenance features.
Emit Group nodes with CONTAINS/EQUIVALENT_TO edges and publish a Dedupe Report.

agents.purpose: Transform scoped sources into unverified claims with supporting citations.
plans: Load scope context and enforce sequester rules.
Extract candidate claims with citation mapping.
Annotate gaps requiring Planner or Verifier follow-up.

agents.purpose: Execute verification plans and update claim statuses with receipts.
plans: Validate claim selection and match against verifier plan capacity.
Execute verifier checks with budget-aware backoff.
Write VerifierRun artifacts and update claim statuses.

agents.purpose: Compose UnifiedDoc sections using verified and pending claims.
plans: Load claims index and enforce doc_targets_tokens budgets.
Draft section outline mapped to supporting citations.
Emit UnifiedDoc section tagged with ring level and outstanding gaps.

agents.purpose: Convert POR gaps and trust deficits into actionable tasks for downstream agents.
plans: Aggregate deficits and outstanding questions from receipts.
Rank gaps by risk and required verification depth.
Emit task list with suggested agent invocations and success metrics.

agents.purpose: Execute approved Business-tier workflows and log resulting artifacts.
plans: Validate approval scope and action readiness.
Execute workflow with sandboxed connectors and capture artifacts.
Emit logs and optional ACK claims; route failures to dead-letter queue.

agents.purpose: Monitor trust metrics and recommend refresh operations across boards.
plans: Load board graph metrics and compare against objectivity bands.
Detect drift in verification freshness and trust scores.
Emit diff proposals, badge adjustments, and refresh recommendations.
